description: Get OHLC price candles for The Standard Reserve (TSR)'s ETH/STANDARD Uniswap v4 pool on Robinhood Chain, priced in ETH per STANDARD, with per-candle swap counts and volume in both tokens. Pass quote="usd" to add open_usd/high_usd/low_usd/close_usd to every candle, derived from Chainlink's ETH/USD feed and treated as an approximation rather than a true historical USD candle; every *_usd field comes back null when that feed reading is stale. Pick a timeframe with tf (1m to 1d, default 1h) and optionally bound the window with from/to (RFC 3339); without them the API returns the most recent 300 candles. Empty buckets are omitted.

quote.description: eth (default) returns OHLC in ETH per STANDARD only; usd adds open_usd/high_usd/low_usd/close_usd from the Chainlink ETH/USD feed

to.description: Window end, RFC 3339 (exclusive); defaults to now

name: 1s_std_candles
title: TSR Price Candles
